result.stdout:
Description:
  Build, test, and debug your AI coding environment like software.

Usage:
  axm [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  doctor            Check the repo's health: its instruction files in any repo, and every asset when it holds a vault.
  validate          Check every asset and print only the problems, for CI and hooks.
  list              List the vault's assets by kind, with maturity, version and harness support.
  explain <path>    Show which instruction files each harness loads for a file, and which it drops, each with its rule.
  triggers          Find skills whose descriptions overlap in each harness's listing, and the terms they share.
  eval              Run the vault's behavioral and regression evals on the real harnesses, in a sealed home.
  conflicts <path>  Have a model find instructions a file gets that contradict each other, each quoted from its file.
  hook              Hooks for Claude Code to run. Each reads the hook's JSON on stdin.

Description:
  Show which instruction files each harness loads for a file, and which it drops, each with its rule.

Usage:
  axm explain <path> [options]

Arguments:
  <path>  The file to explain. It needn't exist yet, but its folder must.

Options:
  --harness <all|claude-code|codex>  Only this harness. [default: all]
  --cwd <cwd>                        Where the harness starts. Defaults to the repo root, or the current directory outside a repo.
  --diff                             Only the files one harness loads and the other doesn't.
  --json                             Print JSON. Its shape is a contract, versioned by schemaVersion.
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information

Description:
  Find skills whose descriptions overlap in each harness's listing, and the terms they share.

Usage:
  axm triggers [command] [options]

Options:
  --root <root>   Where to start. The harnesses launch at the repo root above it, and the vault there or at --root adds its skills. Defaults to the current directory. [default: /tmp/inspectra-help-axioma-1aed5e84-914392e7]
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information

Commands:
  generate <skill>  Have Claude Code write trigger prompts for a vault skill, show them, and write them after you approve.
  test <skill>      Run each vault skill's trigger prompts on the real harnesses, and report which skill each run picked.
  export <skill>    Print a vault skill's trigger prompts in a format other skill-eval tools run.

Description:
  Have a model find instructions a file gets that contradict each other, each quoted from its file.

Usage:
  axm conflicts <path> [options]

Arguments:
  <path>  The file whose instructions to judge. It needn't exist yet, but its folder must.

Options:
  --judge                            Ask a model which of the file's instructions contradict each other. Nothing is judged without it.
  --judge-with <claude-code|codex>   The harness whose model judges. [default: claude-code]
  --harness <all|claude-code|codex>  Only the instructions this harness loads. [default: all]
  --cwd <cwd>                        Where the harness starts. Defaults to the repo root, or the current directory outside a repo.
  --model <model>                    The model that judges. Defaults to the one the judging harness is set to.
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information

Description:
  Run each asset's eval cases on the real harnesses, and report how many runs passed and what they used.

Usage:
  axm eval run [<asset>...] [options]

Arguments:
  <asset>  The assets to run, by name, or by folder such as skills/deploy when two share a name. Defaults to every asset with eval cases.

Options:
  --root <root>                      Where to start. The vault is here or at the repo root above it. Defaults to the current directory. [default: /tmp/inspectra-help-axioma-1aed5e84-914392e7]
  --harness <all|claude-code|codex>  Only this harness. [default: all]
  --runs <runs>                      How many times each case runs on each harness. [default: 3]
  --model <model>                    The model each harness runs. Defaults to the one you chose for it.
  --json                             Print the result as JSON, shape 1.
  --judge-with <claude-code|codex>   The harness whose model grades each run against its case's rubric, as model judgment. Defaults to Claude Code. [default: claude-code]
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information

result.stdout:
Description:
  Run an asset's eval cases on a baseline and on the working tree, and show both side by side.

Usage:
  axm eval compare <asset> [options]

Arguments:
  <asset>  The asset to compare, by name, or by folder such as skills/deploy when two share a name.

Options:
  --baseline <baseline>              What to compare the working tree with: a git ref, or none for no asset at all. Defaults to HEAD. [default: HEAD]
  --root <root>                      Where to start. The vault is here or at the repo root above it. Defaults to the current directory. [default: /tmp/inspectra-help-axioma-1aed5e84-914392e7]
  --harness <all|claude-code|codex>  Only this harness. [default: all]
  --runs <runs>                      How many times each case runs on each harness, for each version. [default: 3]
  --model <model>                    The model each harness runs. Defaults to the one you chose for it.
  --fresh                            Run the baseline again, even when a saved run still describes it.
  --json                             Print the result as JSON, shape 1.
  --judge-with <claude-code|codex>   The harness whose model grades each run against its case's rubric, as model judgment. Defaults to Claude Code. [default: claude-code]
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information
